subsection: SF-016 Transaction, event and audit behavior
context_en: SF-016 Transaction, event and audit behavior
source_quote_en: **Confirmed:** Durable changes propagate `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and correlation context. They are server/interface metadata, not mandatory user-editable fields. Case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts commit in one ACID transaction; search/webhooks reconcile asynchronously. Cross-service writes are idempotent. Job-creating POSTs require `Idempotency-Key`: identical payload replay returns original outcome, changed fingerprint returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Actor/request-fingerprint outcomes are retained for 24 hours. (pp.15–17, 25, 52, 54, 89 [screen_functions:r1:c6:f2, screen_functions:r1:c6:f4, screen_functions:r1:c9:f6, screen_functions:r1:c17:f5, screen_functions:r1:c18:f4, screen_functions:r1:c30:f1–f2]).
atomic_statement_en: Confirmed: Durable changes propagate `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and correlation context.

source_quote_en: **Confirmed design targets:** API availability `99.9%` monthly; case-create P95 **under 300 ms** under defined load (p.12 also says **within 300 ms**, boundary wording needs OQ-017); search P95 **under 1.5 s**, excluding remote connector fetch; model-generation latency measured separately. source_quote_en: Delayed-index recovery: **Detect → Contain → Diagnose → Recover → Verify → Document**. Alert oldest queue age/backlog, identify tenant/generation; pause **only faulty connector/indexer shard** and preserve accepted records; inspect event/outbox/parser/throttle/ACL; replay validated bounded operator-controlled outbox; compare fingerprints/indexed versions and denied probes before closure; link audit IDs/time window/blast radius/quality/prevention. Bounds/closure authority are **BR-OQ-014**. [p.90 c31:f6–f10.]
atomic_statement_en: Delayed-index recovery: Detect → Contain → Diagnose → Recover → Verify → Document.

source_quote_en: Critical isolation/approval tests allow **zero exceptions**, and unmitigated critical findings block regardless of benchmark score. SEC-001–SEC-012 require independent security-control evidence/reproduction/signature. Prompt/model roll-forward requires reevaluation; low statistical confidence blocks release, not equivalence. Deterministic tests avoid live models, pin adapters and randomized retries leave one outcome. Fixtures synthetic/successful/empty/mixed/adversarial/malformed, seeds recorded, corpora frozen/versioned/independently reviewed and signed release-digest-linked outputs retained.
